reviews.title: Calibrate AS2 simulated/bounded Player APIs from working to partial (A-01)
reviews.summary: Demotes AS2 live RTMP streaming, hardware Camera/Microphone capture, XMLSocket, LocalConnection, remote SharedObject, PrintJob, FileReference, IME and external _levelN SWF loading from working to partial with explicit limitation notes.
